turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Why did you ultimately decide not to renew your contract?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mainly budget reallocation to a different initiative this year, not a product complaint. If our budget situation changes next year we'd genuinely consider coming back.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Was there anything product-side that made the decision easier?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The lack of an annual prepay discount option made it hard to justify to finance compared to a competitor offering 20% off for annual commitment.
